name: Telepathic
description: You can speak telepathically to any creature you can see within 60 feet. Your telepathic utterances are in a language you know, and the creature understands you only if it knows that language. You can cast Detect Thoughts once without expending a spell slot. Once you cast it in this way, you can't do so again until you finish a Long Rest. You can also cast it using spell slots you have of the appropriate level.
